platform_review_id.description: Suggested identity key with platform for sync tooling (unique per platform). Not a hard layout rule.

reviewer_image.description: Avatar URL or path relative to the data root. Any working URL/path is fine; assets/images/reviewers/<platform>-<id>.<ext> is only a sync-tooling convention.

review_url.description: Optional. When set (or platforms.*.card_link page_url resolves), the card is a link with a View on cue. When no href resolves, the card is not clickable and has no footer link text.

nofollow.description: When set, overrides platforms.<key>.nofollow for this card's outbound link.

noreferrer.description: When set, overrides platforms.<key>.noreferrer for this card's outbound link.

rel.description: Optional space-separated rel tokens; when set (or with nofollow/noreferrer), overrides the platform for this card. noopener is always applied.

hidden.description: Optional. true keeps the review in the data but hides it everywhere: not shown, counted, averaged or included in the JSON-LD. An object hides only the parts set to true (missing = shown): display = no card; rating = left out of the average and every count; schema = left out of the JSON-LD.

display.description: true: no card for this review.

rating.description: true: not in the average or any count (header, filter tabs, badge, JSON-LD aggregateRating).

schema.description: true: not in the JSON-LD (neither a review item nor the aggregateRating).

example.description: Optional, and rarely needed: everything in the bundled examples folder (template/data/) already counts as example content without it. true marks this review in your own content as an example, so it is left out of everything the widget publishes (cards, counts, averages, JSON-LD) when include_examples is false. See include_examples.

duplicate_of.description: Optional. Key <platform>-<platform_review_id> of another record that is the same review (e.g. posted on two platforms with slightly different text). The widget shows and counts them once. Identical text is merged automatically (display.dedupe).

excerpt.description: Optional. An exact passage of text (whitespace may differ) shown on the card instead of the opening characters, with ellipses where it starts or ends mid-text. The full text stays in the data.
